## Loading packages

```{r packages}
library(here)
library(haven)
library(readr)
```

```{r Reading Main Datasets}
Kenya <- 
  read_csv("Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Kenya_processed.csv")
Liberia <- read_csv("Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Liberia_processed.csv")
Niger <- read_csv("Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Niger_processed.csv")
Rwanda <- read_csv("Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Rwanda_processed.csv")
Zambia <- read_csv("Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Zambia_processed.csv")

```

``` {r Converting to USD}
kenyaExchange = 1

Kenya$GridConnectionFeeUSD = Kenya$GridConnectionFeeLocal * kenyaExchange
Kenya$InternalWiringFeeUSD = Kenya$InternalWiringFeeLocal * kenyaExchange
Kenya$ElectricitBillPriceUSD = Kenya$ElectricityBillPriceLocal * kenyaExchange
Kenya$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = Kenya$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal * kenyaExchange

LiberiaExchange = 1

Liberia$GridConnectionFeeUSD = Liberia$GridConnectionFeeLocal * LiberiaExchange
Liberia$InternalWiringFeeUSD = Liberia$InternalWiringFeeLocal * LiberiaExchange
Liberia$ElectricitBillPriceUSD = Liberia$ElectricityBillPriceLocal * LiberiaExchange
Liberia$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = Liberia$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal * LiberiaExchange

NigerExchange = 1

Niger$GridConnectionFeeUSD = Niger$GridConnectionFeeLocal * NigerExchange
Niger$InternalWiringFeeUSD = Niger$InternalWiringFeeLocal * NigerExchange
Niger$ElectricitBillPriceUSD = Niger$ElectricityBillPriceLocal * NigerExchange
Niger$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = Niger$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal * NigerExchange

RwandaExchange = 1

Rwanda$GridConnectionFeeUSD = Rwanda$GridConnectionFeeLocal * RwandaExchange
Rwanda$InternalWiringFeeUSD = Rwanda$InternalWiringFeeLocal * RwandaExchange
Rwanda$ElectricitBillPriceUSD = Rwanda$ElectricityBillPriceLocal * RwandaExchange
Rwanda$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = Rwanda$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal * RwandaExchange

ZambiaExchange = 1

Zambia$GridConnectionFeeUSD = Zambia$GridConnectionFeeLocal * ZambiaExchange
Zambia$InternalWiringFeeUSD = Zambia$InternalWiringFeeLocal * ZambiaExchange
Zambia$ElectricitBillPriceUSD = Zambia$ElectricityBillPriceLocal * ZambiaExchange
Zambia$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = Zambia$EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal * ZambiaExchange

```

``` {r Re-writing the files}
write.csv(Kenya, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Kenya_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Liberia, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Liberia_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Niger, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Niger_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Rwanda, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Rwanda_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Zambia, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Zambia_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)


All_Combined <- rbind(Kenya, Liberia, Niger, Rwanda, Zambia)
write.csv(All_Combined, "Data/Processed/AllCountries_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
